SELECT ic.indu_class_no AS induClassNo, ic.indu_class_name AS induClassName,
i.indu_no AS induNo, i.indu_class_no AS induInduClassNo, -- 조인에서 구분용 별칭! i.indu_name AS induName,
bt.business_type_no AS businessTypeNo, bt.indu_no AS btInduNo, -- 구분용 별칭! bt.business_type_name AS businessTypeName
FROM indu_class_code ic LEFT JOIN indu_code i ON ic.indu_class_no = i.indu_class_no LEFT JOIN business_type_code bt ON i.indu_no = bt.indu_no ORDER BY ic.indu_class_no, i.indu_no, bt.business_type_no
SELECT INDU_CLASS_NO , INDU_CLASS_NAME FROM INDU_CLASS_CODE WHERE INDU_CLASS_NO = #{induClassNo}
